subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it use an existing `includeAttachments`-style policy or a Feishu-specific media mode?
rationale: The reported key is not a documented or shipped Feishu contract, and adding it expands channel configuration/default behavior that existing users depend on for media handling.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use A Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one setting family across channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Document that Feishu supports `mediaMaxMb` but no file-content ignore switch if maintainers do not want another config option.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: PR 47968 makes Takhoffman the strongest recent owner for Feishu media behavior and docs policy shape.
